Oracle GoldenGate 23ai: The Replicat Process

In this episode, Lois Houston and Nikita Abraham, along with Nick Wagner, Senior Director of Product Management, dive into the Replicat process in Oracle GoldenGate 23ai. They discuss how Replicat applies changes to the target database, highlighting the different types: Classic, Coordinated, and Par
